UplinkSwitch API works: api.uplinkswitch.com/v1/models → 200.

Let me check uplinkswitch models (uncensored count) + pricing/free.

Then write results.

Let me fetch models and count uncensored, and check if free credits exist (maybe /v1/me or pricing API).

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 200 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
r=urllib.request.Request("https://api.uplinkswitch.com/v1/models",headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=30) as x: d=json.load(x)
ms=d.get("data",d if isinstance(d,list) else [])
print("total model:",len(ms))
ids=[m.get("id") for m in ms if isinstance(m,dict)]
unc=[i for i in ids if i and any(k in i.lower() for k in ("uncensored","abliterated"))]
print("uncensored/abliterated:",len(unc))
for i in unc[:12]: print("  ",i)
print("contoh:",ids[:5])
PY
